hint.title: The path exists in the snapshot but contains nothing
hint.text: The backup ran, the directory was included, and it was empty when it ran. The classic cause is backing up a bind-mount path while the application actually stores its data in a *named volume* mounted over the top of it, so the host directory the backup reads is a hollow shell. `docker inspect <container> --format '{{ .Mounts }}'` on the live system shows where the data really is.
